description: Longitud de red de agua is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by OSE. Este conjunto de datos presenta información sobre la longitud de la red de agua potable de OSE, expresada en kilómetros. Los datos permiten analizar la extensión de la infraestructura de distribución de agua potable por territorio, constituyendo un insumo relevante para la gestión y transparencia de la infraestructura hidráulica. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher OSE. Its tags are Agua, Harvest, Redes. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-02-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
